rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a word or phrase with the same meaning as another.

example.english: The teacher asked us to find a synonym for “fast.”
example.traditional: 老師叫我哋搵出「快」嘅同義詞。
example.jyutping: lou5 si1 giu3 ngo5 dei6 wan2 ceot1 faai3 ge3 tung4 ji6 ci4

rows.jyutping: ji3 si1 soeng1 tung4 ge3 ci4
rows.note: Use this plain Cantonese description when explaining the idea instead of using the technical term 同義詞.

example.english: These two words mean the same thing, so one is a synonym for the other.
example.traditional: 呢兩個詞意思一樣，其中一個就係另一個嘅意思相同嘅詞。
example.jyutping: nei1 loeng5 go3 ci4 ji3 si1 jat1 joeng6 kei4 zung1 jat1 go3 zau6 hai6 ling6 jat1 go3 ge3 ji3 si1 soeng1 tung4 ge3 ci4
